pages.title: Wake
pages.text:
**Soil.** Wood, dirt, a bench, a sapling, a chest, warmth. Melt ice with lava for water on Normal and Hard. Cook something.\
The Soil token comes from the **Soil Knot** at the end of the chapter. Raise a Tension Post and seat it. The pad starts mending you.

pages.title: Before you move on
pages.text:
Finish Soil in the quest screen. Claim the **Soil Knot**, then seat the Soil token. The Soil notch lights.\
Read **Start here** for worked examples. Recipes live in JEI; the **Spirit Codex** covers Tribal Power machinery. If you get stuck, test one recipe at a time and sneak-use the Spirit Codex on a silent machine.
